name: Tinker Function Over Form scales Aether Augmentation (#1344)
contract: Function Over Form 572538 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER +50 on SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 (DBC EffectBasePoints 49, DieSides 1) with class mask 0x8, which selects the two Aether Augmentation passives, both SpellFamilyName 34 with SpellFamilyFlags[0] 0x8. SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 addresses effect index 0 only (Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers, Unit.cpp:12084-12103) and SpellInfo::CalcValue truncates, so 653232's effect 0 goes from 25 (EffectBasePoints 24, DieSides 1) to int32(25 * 1.5) = 37 and 653275's effect 0 from -10 (EffectBasePoints -11, DieSides 1) to -15. 653232's effect 1 is the control: same spell, index 1, so SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 must leave its 25 alone.

steps.label: Aether Augmentation's crit bonus is the DBC's 25
Its magic damage reduction is the DBC's -10
Function Over Form raises the crit bonus to 37
It deepens the magic damage reduction to -15
